image_description: A Gothic-style stone altar situated within a vaulted chapel niche. The altar features a heavy, ornate stone superstructure with carved detailing and a flat top slab, supported by a solid base. It is flanked by tall, narrow stained-glass windows and sits beneath a ribbed stone vault ceiling. The lighting is dim, creating high contrast between the illuminated windows and the shadowed stone architecture.
